# Objective

Compare two synthetic two-asset predictive clouds with Energy Score, Variogram Score, marginal CRPS, PIT rank, and interval coverage.

# Run

```bash
python python/qm015_probabilistic_evaluation.py
```

# Check

The script prints one line per model. The point is not that one model must dominate every metric; inspect which diagnostics disagree and explain what dimension each one is measuring.

# Experiment

Change the off-diagonal covariance in Model B while keeping its marginal variances fixed. Observe how the Variogram Score reacts relative to the componentwise CRPS.

The data are synthetic and carry no empirical performance claim.
